answer.justification: Activation measurements match system-prompted. The layer-2 spike is 31.2, close to the system-prompted range of 31.7–64.0 and far above the 0.7–6.1 seen for fine-tuned and 0.8–2.8 for quantized. The final-layer cosine is 0.835 (low), effective rank 2.86 (concentrated), direction consistency 0.543, and size ratio 0.973 (below 1) all fit system-prompted. Fine-tuned is ruled out because its size ratio is above 1, its layer-16 difference is at most 0.194, and its layer-2 spike is small. Quantized is ruled out because its internal differences are much smaller and flatter, and its size ratio and rank differ.
